title: Boundary Locator

story.briefing: This log is sorted but full of repeats. The network needs the exact span a value occupies, not merely whether it is present.
story.success: Boundaries located. The span is reported to the byte.

description: Given an array sorted in non-decreasing order (values may repeat) and a target, return the first and last index at which the target appears, as a two-element array. If the target does not appear, return [-1, -1].
hints: Finding some occurrence is the easy part. Finding the *first* one means that on a match you have not finished — there may be another match to the left.
Do not walk outwards from a match you found. A long run of equal values turns that into a linear scan and defeats the point.
Run two separate searches. In the first, on a match record the position and continue searching the left half. In the second, on a match record it and continue searching the right half.
